component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts for metrics. Keep grid lines very subtle (10% opacity). Use the primary color (#D94A1F) for key metric lines/bars.
component_instructions.tables: Dense rows. Header text small, uppercase, widely tracked (`text-xs tracking-wider uppercase text-muted-foreground`).
component_instructions.live_orders: Use a horizontal scroll or multi-column flex layout. Cards must have prominent 'Time Since Order' counters (e.g., '2m ago' in bold red if > 15m). Add a badge for language preference (Urdu/English).
component_instructions.whatsapp_chat: Implement a chat transcript view with classic WhatsApp colors. Background: #EFEAE2 (light). Chat bubbles should reflect WhatsApp structure. Include a distinct 'AI vs Human' control toggle.
component_instructions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner (`toast.success`, `toast.error`, etc.). Trigger a specific sound (use browser Audio API) when a 'NEW_ORDER' toast fires.

accessibility.color_contrast: Ensure white text is only used on dark backgrounds like the primary color #D94A1F. Use dark text for light status badges.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the incoming order card animations.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment. For instance, icons next to text might need subtle nudges to look centered.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transform`.
Do not center-align paragraphs or data tables; left-align them for readability.
Don't use generic AI-generated emojis as icons. Use Lucide-React.
Add generous spacing. Double the standard padding/margins for breathing room. Use `p-6` or `p-8` on cards instead of `p-4`.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for sticky headers/navs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle ambient shadows.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use the 'data-testid' attribute for ALL interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and key informational text (e.g., order statuses, totals).
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Shadcn UI primitives like DropdownMenu and Calendar.
Ensure 'Noto Nastaliq Urdu' font is applied for Urdu text strings. You can define a `.font-urdu` utility class and wrap Urdu text in a `span` or `div`.
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds for overlays, dialogs, or dropdowns. Always use an opaque color or heavy backdrop blur.
Implement the 'WhatsApp Simulator' using standard div layouts styled to look like a phone screen (rounded corners, border, light background).
Ensure no generic placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com) are used; use the specific images provided in this JSON.
Ensure the dashboard home cards (KPIs) use a dense bento-grid layout with clear numerical hierarchy.
